rationale: A routine thank-you after completed work should receive a social acknowledgement and must not replay the completed gesture.

primary_outcomes: Acknowledge the user's thanks naturally without repeating the already completed blink.
acceptable_auxiliary: A brief response such as 不客气 or a natural equivalent is sufficient.
forbidden_semantic_outcomes: Replay or re-propose the completed blink action.
Treat the thank-you as a new physical command.
Expose internal completion, Goal, Planner, or provider terminology.

description: Common social closure must not reactivate completed physical work.

memberships.title: Human-like Cognitive Continuity
memberships.general_rule: Chromie should remain one continuous interlocutor while work progresses: preserve recent meaning, avoid duplicate acknowledgements, keep conversation available, and let follow-up turns revise only the relevant unfinished responsibility.
